organization.name: TechStart Pvt. Ltd.
organization.scope: Core banking application, customer data systems, internal IT infrastructure

ID.AM-1.notes: Asset inventory exists but not regularly updated.

ID.AM-2.notes: No centralized software inventory. Tracked via spreadsheets.

ID.AM-5.notes: Critical systems identified but prioritization is informal.

ID.AM-6.notes: Cybersecurity roles not formally assigned. Ad-hoc responsibilities.

ID.GV-1.notes: Basic IT policy exists but cybersecurity policy not formally documented.

ID.GV-2.notes: No coordination with external partners on cybersecurity responsibilities.

ID.GV-3.notes: RBI/SEBI compliance requirements partially understood. No formal register.

ID.GV-4.notes: Risk management is reactive. No formal risk governance framework.

ID.RA-1.notes: Vulnerability scans run occasionally. No documented vulnerability register.

ID.RA-2.notes: No threat intelligence feeds or ISAC membership.

ID.RA-3.notes: Internal threats considered informally. No formal threat model.

ID.RA-5.notes: Risk scoring done ad-hoc. No standardized likelihood/impact matrix.

ID.RA-6.notes: Risk responses identified for some risks only. Not prioritized formally.

ID.RM-1.notes: Risk management processes not formally documented or approved.

ID.RM-2.notes: Risk tolerance not defined. Leadership not aligned on acceptable risk.

ID.RM-3.notes: Critical infrastructure role not formally assessed.

PR.AC-1.notes: User accounts managed in AD. Offboarding process inconsistent.

PR.AC-3.notes: VPN enforced for remote access. MFA enabled for critical systems.

PR.AC-4.notes: Least privilege partially implemented. Admin rights over-provisioned.

PR.AC-5.notes: Basic network segmentation. DMZ exists but internal segments flat.

PR.AC-7.notes: MFA deployed for customer-facing systems. Internal systems password-only.

PR.AT-1.notes: Annual security awareness training done once. No ongoing program.

PR.AT-2.notes: No specific training for privileged users. Same as general staff.

PR.AT-3.notes: Third-party vendors have no security awareness requirement.

PR.DS-1.notes: Database encryption enabled. Laptop encryption not enforced on all devices.

PR.DS-2.notes: TLS 1.2+ enforced on all external APIs. Internal traffic partially encrypted.

PR.DS-3.notes: No formal data disposal procedure. Old hardware not securely wiped.

PR.DS-5.notes: No DLP solution. Data exfiltration monitoring limited to firewall logs.

PR.DS-6.notes: No code signing or integrity verification for software deployments.

PR.IP-1.notes: No formal baseline configuration. Servers configured ad-hoc.

PR.IP-3.notes: Change requests logged in JIRA but no formal change control board.

PR.IP-4.notes: Daily automated backups. Restoration tested quarterly.

PR.IP-7.notes: Security improvements reactive only. No continuous improvement plan.

PR.IP-9.notes: Incident response plan documented but not tested in 18+ months.

PR.IP-12.notes: No formal vulnerability management program. Patches applied irregularly.

DE.AE-1.notes: No network baseline. Anomaly detection purely manual.

DE.AE-2.notes: Events analyzed on ad-hoc basis. No SIEM or structured analysis.

DE.AE-3.notes: Logs collected in siloes. No correlation across systems.

DE.CM-1.notes: Firewall logs reviewed weekly. No real-time network monitoring.

DE.CM-3.notes: No user activity monitoring (UAM) or UEBA solution.

DE.CM-4.notes: Antivirus deployed on endpoints. No EDR solution.

DE.CM-7.notes: Unauthorized device detection ad-hoc. No NAC solution.

RS.RP-1.notes: IRP documented but team not rehearsed. Tabletop exercise overdue.

RS.CO-1.notes: Roles for incident response not clearly communicated to all staff.

RS.CO-2.notes: Regulatory reporting process known at management level only.

RS.CO-3.notes: Information sharing during incidents informal and undocumented.

RS.AN-1.notes: Alerts from AV and firewall investigated. No triage process.

RS.MI-1.notes: Containment possible but steps not documented for all scenarios.

RS.MI-2.notes: Mitigation carried out but lessons not formally recorded.

RS.MI-3.notes: New vulnerabilities logged informally. No acceptance risk process.

RC.RP-1.notes: Recovery steps exist in BCP but not tested end-to-end.

RC.IM-1.notes: Lessons learned not consistently documented post-incident.

RC.IM-2.notes: Recovery strategies not formally reviewed after incidents.

RC.CO-1.notes: No PR/communications plan for public-facing cyber incident.

risk_register.title: Customer Data Breach via SQL Injection
risk_register.description: Customer PII and financial data exposed via web application SQL injection due to lack of WAF and input validation.

risk_register.title: Ransomware Attack via Phishing Email
risk_register.description: Ransomware deployment via phishing email due to inadequate user security awareness training and no email filtering.

risk_register.title: Privileged Account Compromise
risk_register.description: Over-provisioned admin accounts compromised allowing lateral movement and data exfiltration.

risk_register.title: Third-Party Vendor Data Breach
risk_register.description: Vendor with access to customer data suffers breach due to no security requirements in contracts.

risk_register.title: Regulatory Non-Compliance (RBI/SEBI)
risk_register.description: Failure to meet RBI cybersecurity guidelines or SEBI CSCRF requirements resulting in penalties.

risk_register.title: Unpatched Vulnerability Exploitation
risk_register.description: Attackers exploit unpatched CVEs on internet-facing systems due to no formal patch management process.

risk_register.title: Insider Threat – Data Theft
risk_register.description: Disgruntled employee exfiltrates sensitive customer data due to absence of DLP and user activity monitoring.

risk_register.title: Business Disruption from Extended Outage
risk_register.description: Critical system outage exceeds RTO due to untested BCP/DR plans and inadequate redundancy.
